why: A's bookcase is a true black-metal-and-warm-wood étagère that matches the honey beams and the coffee table. B's low console has a pale whitewashed top and mostly black shelves, so it misses the brief. Neither rug is really earth-toned (A's is grey, B's is mostly navy), but A's quieter rug keeps the leather, wood and dark metal look more cohesive.
